This draft shows how prose, mathematical notation, and a short argument sit together on the page.

## The calculation

For a positive integer $n$, write $S_n = 1 + 2 + \cdots + n$. Adding the same terms in reverse order gives

$$
\begin{aligned}
S_n &= 1 + 2 + \cdots + n, \\
S_n &= n + (n-1) + \cdots + 1.
\end{aligned}
$$

Each of the $n$ columns sums to $n+1$, so

$$
S_n = \frac{n(n+1)}{2}.
$$

For example, when $n=4$, this gives $1+2+3+4=10$.[^note]

[^note]: This sample remains a draft and is excluded from the published site.
